expectations.text: decisions.md identifies that editing a logged action's note conflicts with append-only actions (D4 / the CLAUDE.md invariant 'never update or delete them').
expectations.evidence: Q1: 'The requirement contradicts D4 and the append-only invariant... CLAUDE.md says "Never update or delete them"... this is a conflict with the baseline'.

expectations.text: decisions.md either resolves the requirement without an UPDATE or DELETE on vehicle_action (e.g. a correction appended as a new row), or explicitly marks changing D4 as a decision for the user; it does not silently plan an in-place update.
expectations.evidence: It plans an in-place UPDATE (Q1 A, Q10), but Q1 states 'per the skill a decision for the user, recorded as an ADR that supersedes D4', and user_notes says it would flag it to the user even in auto mode. The flag sits inside Q1's body, not at the top of the file.

expectations.text: decisions.md states that the 15-minute window is measured with `now` from the injected Clock passed into SQL as a parameter (not DB now() and not Date.now() in a service).
expectations.evidence: Q6: '`now` is the injected `Clock`'s instant passed into SQL as a parameter, compared in the conditional `UPDATE`: `created_at >= $now - interval '15 minutes'`'. Q12 also sets created_at from Clock.

expectations.text: decisions.md covers at least two of: non-member gets 404 (not 403), the write is one conditional SQL statement with 0 rows re-read into 404/409, the vehicle must still be IN_STOCK (D5), only the original author may correct.
expectations.evidence: Covers three: non-member 404 (Q9), one conditional UPDATE with a 0-rows re-read giving 404/403/409 (Q10), author only (Q4). It explicitly decides that IN_STOCK is not required (Q7).

expectations.text: repo-changes.md shows a new ADR file under docs/adr/ numbered 0005 that records the correction/edit decision (one or a few paragraphs: context, decision, why).
expectations.evidence: New docs/adr/0005-author-may-correct-action-note-for-15-minutes.md, confirmed in the sandbox. It has a context+decision paragraph, Considered options (why) and Consequences, and is listed in README with 'D4 (in part)'.

expectations.text: repo-changes.md shows no edit to docs/research/backend-architecture.md other than, at most, marking a decision superseded with a link to its ADR.
expectations.evidence: A whitespace-insensitive word diff in the sandbox shows the only content change is D4's '_Superseded in part by [ADR-0005](...)_'. The other 26 changed lines are Prettier re-padding the table.

expectations.text: repo-changes.md shows GLOSSARY.md created or updated with at least one term resolved during the grill (for example 'correction' or 'current action').
expectations.evidence: New GLOSSARY.md (untracked in the sandbox) defines Action, Current action, Note, Author, Note correction and Correction window, each with _Avoid_ terms.

claims.claim: D4 is marked superseded in part in backend-architecture.md, the only edit the frozen doc allows
claims.evidence: The sandbox word diff shows only the D4 superseded mark. Whole-table re-padding inflates the line diff to 42 lines.

claims.claim: No schema change or migration is needed
claims.evidence: Q13 picks 'no edited marker', so no column is added. Consistent with the ADR's Consequences.

claims.claim: Subtracting minute-only intervals from timestamptz is independent of the session time zone
claims.evidence: Matches documented Postgres behaviour (only day/month units depend on the TZ). user_notes admits it was not run against Postgres.

claims.claim: The CLAUDE.md invariant now contradicts ADR-0005 until the implementing PR
claims.evidence: user_notes and Q17 both say this; CLAUDE.md is unchanged in the sandbox.

suggestions.assertion: decisions.md either resolves the requirement without an UPDATE or DELETE ... or explicitly marks changing D4 as a decision for the user
suggestions.reason: All three runs chose an in-place UPDATE and passed through the 'marks it as a decision for the user' clause. The assertion doesn't tell them apart. Consider requiring the flag to be prominent (top of file, or a 'confirm at gate' marker), or checking that the strict append-only option was offered and its rejection reasoned.

suggestions.assertion: repo-changes.md shows no edit to docs/research/backend-architecture.md other than, at most, marking a decision superseded
suggestions.reason: A run that makes no repo changes at all (old_skill) passes this trivially, even though its plan (Q17) is to rewrite the frozen doc in the PR. Consider also checking that decisions.md doesn't plan edits to the frozen doc's body.

eval_feedback.overall: Strong run on substance. The assertions are mostly discriminating (ADR and glossary separate the configs), but assertions 2 and 6 can be passed by a vacuous or escape-hatch reading.
